summary: The app's icon set: a table of Lucide-style SVG shapes keyed by name, plus `icon()`, which wraps a shape in a correctly sized `svg` element and marks it as trusted markup with `raw()`. Pages, charts, the command palette, the drawer and components.js all call `icon()`, and `EVENT_ICONS` gives each event type a consistent symbol. Keeping the icons inline means no icon font and no extra downloads.

notes.text: File header comment. The icons copy the Lucide style (shapes drawn on a 24×24 grid with a 1.6px stroke) and live inline in this file as SVG markup, so the app needs no icon font and no extra downloads.
Imports `raw()` from the DOM helpers. `raw` marks a string as trusted HTML, so when an icon is placed inside the auto-escaping `html` template it is inserted as markup instead of being shown as text.

`PATHS` maps each icon name to the inner shapes of that icon (`path`, `circle`, `rect`, `polyline`...). Only the shapes are stored; the outer `svg` element is added by `icon()` below, so every icon shares the same size and stroke settings.

Page icons: `overview` (four dashboard tiles), `activity` (a pulse line for Events, and the fallback for unknown names), `shield` (Incidents), `users` (two people for Customers) and `user` (one person, shown on customer entries in the command palette).

More page icons: `flask` (Risk Lab), `zap` (a lightning bolt for Simulation and scenario replays), `plug` (Integration) and `sparkles` (AI Analyst). The side navigation in `index.html` inlines the same shapes, and the command palette's Go to entries use these names.
Interface glyphs: `search` (a magnifier for the palette and search boxes), `x` (the drawer's Close button) and `chevron` (a right-pointing arrowhead that hints 'this opens something').
`back` (a left-pointing arrowhead for the drawer's Back button) and `arrow` (a right arrow on links such as 'Board' and 'Open').

The four event-type icons that `EVENT_ICONS` (at the end of the file) points to: `login` (an arrow entering a door), `card` (a payment card for transactions), `database` (a cylinder for resource access) and `key` (password resets; the palette also shows it when asking for the API key).
`globe` (the Enrich stage of the Simulation pipeline), `radio` (broadcast waves for live traffic and the Publish stage), `refresh` (a circular arrow for resetting demo data) and `check` (a tick).
`device` (a phone, listed beside each customer device), `plane` (the travel card and the impossible-travel tag in the events table) and `copy` (two overlapping sheets for the Copy as cURL button).

`send` (a paper plane for Send/Ask buttons and the Ingest stage), `lock` (a padlock in the API-key prompt and on secured endpoints), `alert` (a warning triangle used by `errorBox`) and `gauge` (a speedometer for the Score stage).

`layers` (stacked sheets, the default empty-state icon), `wind` (the palette's motion toggle), `book` (API documentation), `target` (a bullseye on the Critical incidents card) and `grip` (a six-dot drag handle on the incident board's draggable cards).

`filter` (a funnel for the Normalize stage and the 'No events match' state). Every icon left in the table is used: nine spares no screen referenced (clock, command, cpu, external, message, pin, power, server, terminal) were removed. The last line closes `PATHS`.
`icon(name, size, cls)` returns one icon as trusted markup. `size` defaults to 16 pixels and `cls` lets a caller add extra CSS classes.

Wraps the stored shapes in an `svg` element: `viewBox="0 0 24 24"` matches the Lucide grid so the icon scales cleanly to any `size`, `stroke="currentColor"` makes it take the colour of the surrounding text, and `aria-hidden="true"` hides it from screen readers because icons are decorative (icon-only buttons carry their own `aria-label`). Unknown names fall back to the `activity` shape. `size` and `cls` go in unescaped, which is fine because only code passes them, never user data.

`EVENT_ICONS` maps each backend `event_type` to an icon name: `login` → `login`, `transaction` → `card`, `resource_access` → `database`, `password_reset` → `key`. `eventIcon()` in components.js uses it so every event type always gets the same symbol.
